mapper.select: SELECT source_updated_time FROM ticket_source_project_mapping WHERE provider_id=#{providerId} AND provider_project_id=#{providerProjectId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_project_mapping SET source_status_value=#{sourceStatusValue}, source_status_text=#{sourceStatusText}, source_updated_time=#{sourceUpdatedTime}, update_time=NOW() WHERE mapping_id=#{mappingId}

UPDATE ticket_source_sku_mapping SET source_status_value=#{sourceStatusValue}, source_status_text=#{sourceStatusText}, source_updated_time=#{sourceUpdatedTime}, update_time=NOW() WHERE provider_id=#{providerId} AND provider_sku_id=#{providerSkuId}
mapper.select: SELECT venue_id FROM performance_session WHERE project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY session_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE venue SET venue_name=#{venueName}, city_name=#{cityName}, address=#{address}, longitude=#{longitude}, latitude=#{latitude}, coordinate_system=#{coordinateSystem}, update_time=NOW() WHERE venue_id=#{venueId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_venue_mapping (provider_id,venue_id,provider_venue_id,mapping_status,last_sync_time,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{providerId},#{venueId},#{providerVenueId},'BOUND',NOW(),NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE venue_id=VALUES(venue_id), mapping_status='BOUND', last_sync_time=NOW(), update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT notice_id FROM notice_item WHERE notice_type=#{noticeType} ORDER BY notice_id LIMIT 1
SELECT notice_id FROM notice_item WHERE title=#{title} ORDER BY notice_id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_notice_rel WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND source_provider_id=#{providerId}
DELETE FROM project_service_tag_rel WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND source_provider_id=#{providerId}
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id FROM service_tag_capability_rel WHERE capability_code=#{capabilityCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT refund_rule_id FROM refund_rule WHERE project_id=#{projectId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_rule SET source_provider_id=#{providerId}, provider_rule_id=#{providerRuleId}, refund_type=#{refundType}, consumer_entry_enabled=#{consumerEntryEnabled}, delivery_fee_refundable=#{deliveryFeeRefundable}, rule_description=#{ruleDescription}, update_time=NOW() WHERE refund_rule_id=#{refundRuleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_promotion_rule (project_mapping_id,provider_promotion_id,promotion_type,promotion_title,promotion_description, start_time,end_time,promotion_status,stackable,target_scope_json,rule_data_json,source_version, source_updated_time,update_time) VALUES (#{projectMappingId},#{providerPromotionId},#{promotionType},#{promotionTitle},#{promotionDescription}, #{startTime},#{endTime},'ENABLED',#{stackable},#{targetScopeJson},#{ruleDataJson},#{sourceVersion}, #{sourceUpdatedTime},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE promotion_type=VALUES(promotion_type),promotion_title=VALUES(promotion_title), promotion_description=VALUES(promotion_description),start_time=VALUES(start_time),end_time=VALUES(end_time), promotion_status='ENABLED',stackable=VALUES(stackable),target_scope_json=VALUES(target_scope_json), rule_data_json=VALUES(rule_data_json),source_version=VALUES(source_version), source_updated_time=VALUES(source_updated_time),update_time=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_campaign_asset SET source_enabled=0,update_time=NOW() WHERE provider_id=#{providerId} AND (#{cityCode} IS NULL OR #{cityCode}='' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{cityCode},city_codes)>0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_campaign_asset (provider_id,provider_asset_id,asset_type,position_code,title,description,image_url,mobile_image_url, target_type,provider_target_id,city_codes,start_time,end_time,provider_promotion_id, review_status,banner_id,source_enabled,source_version,source_updated_time,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{providerId},#{providerAssetId},#{assetType},#{positionCode},#{title},#{description},#{imageUrl},#{mobileImageUrl}, #{targetType},#{providerTargetId},#{cityCodes},#{startTime},#{endTime},#{providerPromotionId}, 'PENDING',NULL,1,#{sourceVersion},#{sourceUpdatedTime},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE asset_type=VALUES(asset_type),position_code=VALUES(position_code),title=VALUES(title), description=VALUES(description),image_url=VALUES(image_url),mobile_image_url=VALUES(mobile_image_url), target_type=VALUES(target_type),provider_target_id=VALUES(provider_target_id),city_codes=VALUES(city_codes), start_time=VALUES(start_time),end_time=VALUES(end_time),provider_promotion_id=VALUES(provider_promotion_id), source_enabled=1,source_version=VALUES(source_version),source_updated_time=VALUES(source_updated_time), update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_id AS projectId, sm.session_id AS sessionId, skm.sku_id AS skuId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, p.provider_code AS providerCode, pm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, sm.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, skm.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, skm.provider_sku_name AS providerSkuName, pm.mapping_status AS projectMappingStatus, sm.mapping_status AS sessionMappingStatus, skm.mapping_status AS skuMappingStatus, skm.source_sale_status AS sourceSaleStatus, skm.inventory_mode AS inventoryMode, skm.available_stock_snapshot AS availableStockSnapshot, skm.face_price AS providerFacePrice, skm.sale_price AS providerSalePrice, skm.settlement_price AS settlementPrice, sku.price AS platformPrice, sku.price_mode AS priceMode, ps.delivery_type AS deliveryType, sku.sku_status AS localSkuStatus, skm.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, skm.last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime FROM ticket_source_project_mapping pm JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=pm.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping sm ON sm.project_mapping_id=pm.mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skm ON skm.session_mapping_id=sm.mapping_id JOIN ticket_sku sku ON sku.sku_id=skm.sku_id JOIN performance_session ps ON ps.session_id=sm.session_id WHERE pm.provider_id=#{providerId} AND pm.provider_project_id=#{providerProjectId} ORDER BY sm.provider_session_id, skm.provider_sku_id

SELECT p.provider_code AS providerCode, pm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, pm.mapping_id AS projectMappingId, pm.project_id AS projectId, lp.project_status AS localProjectStatus, pm.auto_publish_enabled AS autoPublishEnabled, pm.source_sale_status AS sourceStatus, pm.source_status_value AS sourceStatusValue, pm.source_status_text AS sourceStatusText, pm.source_data_version AS sourceVersion, pm.source_updated_time AS sourceUpdatedTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_source_session_mapping sm WHERE sm.project_mapping_id=pm.mapping_id AND sm.mapping_status='BOUND') AS boundSessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping skm JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping sm2 ON sm2.mapping_id=skm.session_mapping_id WHERE sm2.project_mapping_id=pm.mapping_id AND skm.mapping_status='BOUND') AS boundTicketProductCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_notice_rel nr WHERE nr.project_id=pm.project_id AND nr.source_provider_id=pm.provider_id) AS noticeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_service_tag_rel tr WHERE tr.project_id=pm.project_id AND tr.source_provider_id=pm.provider_id) AS serviceTagCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_source_promotion_rule pr WHERE pr.project_mapping_id=pm.mapping_id AND pr.promotion_status='ENABLED') AS promotionCount, rr.refund_type AS refundType, pm.last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, pm.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, pm.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, pm.last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM ticket_source_project_mapping pm JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=pm.provider_id JOIN performance_project lp ON lp.project_id=pm.project_id LEFT JOIN refund_rule rr ON rr.project_id=pm.project_id WHERE pm.provider_id=#{providerId} AND pm.provider_project_id=#{providerProjectId} LIMIT 1
